    pvals.append(p)

m = len(pvals)

sorted_p = np.array(pvals)[order]
adj = sorted_p * m / (np.arange(1,m+1))
# enforce monotonicity from the largest down
adj = np.minimum.accumulate(adj[::-1])[::-1]
adj = np.clip(adj, 0, 1)
adj_p = np.empty(m)
adj_p[order] = adj

for i,b in enumerate(biomarkers):

}
